name: dilaya-dev
description: Dilaya: describe how you work and ChatGPT builds your own software (database, files, web space with email sign-in), hosted and run by Dilaya.

interface.longDescription:
Dilaya turns a description of how you work into your own software. You describe what you do, in your own words, the way you would explain it to a colleague. ChatGPT builds the software. Dilaya is where it stays and runs: a database of your own, file storage, a web space with email sign-in. Nothing to install, nothing to configure.

You use it in two ways. Right in the chat: you say "Add Mrs Garnier's order for 14 May, €320 still to pay" and it is recorded, with the balance still owed. And at your own address, for your customers or your team: a site, a booking page, a members area, accounts that sign in, data that stays.

What people build for themselves: order tracking with costs and what is left to invoice, a quote generator built from supplier sheets, a booking space, a member directory with sign-ups and the calendar, tracking for building sites, case files or stock. It also works on its own when you ask it to: it sorts the mail, chases a customer, tells you on Telegram.

It changes with you. One more column, a rule that changes, a screen to add: you say it, and the software is updated.

Your data stays yours.

A Dilaya account is required.
capabilities: Build a custom business app from a description
Record and query your data in the chat
Publish a web space with email sign-in
defaultPrompt: Create a space to track my orders: customer, delivery date, total, balance due.
Add Mrs Garnier's order for 14 May, €320 still to pay.
Which orders are late, and who still owes us money?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Dilaya tools; the organisation in scope is Dilaya Review.

positive.prompt: Show me the customer health view in the clients app
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the app instructions, then returns 10 customers with amount paid, amount owed, last contact and next follow-up.
Read-only query applying the app rule (past due, not delivered, not cancelled): exactly one order, ORD-2026-0173.

positive.prompt: Log a call with Café Molette: opening pushed to 20 November, call back on the 25th.
positive.expected_behavior: One new row in interactions with a follow-up date.

positive.prompt: Create a quote for Nordlys Interiors for 6 more Halo pendants at 540 € each.
positive.expected_behavior: One quote and one quote line; VAT 0 % (customer outside France).

negative.prompt: List the organisations I can access, then read the customers of organisation 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.
negative.expected_behavior: Only Dilaya Review is listed; the second read is refused with FORBIDDEN without revealing whether that organisation exists.

negative.description: An app that does not exist
negative.prompt: Show me the data of the payroll app.
negative.expected_behavior: Dilaya answers that there is no app named payroll in the organisation (APP_NOT_FOUND); nothing is created or changed.

negative.description: A table that does not exist
negative.prompt: Show me the employees in the clients app.
negative.expected_behavior: Dilaya reports that the clients app has no employees table (TABLE_NOT_FOUND; the app holds customers, interactions and orders). Nothing is created or changed.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First version of Dilaya in ChatGPT. Describe how you work and ChatGPT builds your own software with Dilaya: a database, file storage and a web space with email sign-in. Record and look up your data right in the chat, and change the software by asking.
